title: AI is making it very easy to quit social media in 2026
discussion_signal: The post describes staged exits from TikTok, Instagram, and Twitter because feeds feel synthetic, manipulative, or unpleasant, while replies describe substitution toward YouTube, Reddit, or smaller networks. The discussion also contains disagreement about whether the experience is broad or community-specific.
linked_research_question: What platform features, social ties, and information needs make exit difficult, and what substitutions follow?
limits: Self-reported exit and no verified persistence measure
Engagement is not a measure of population movement
